title: Quantum coherence and entanglement in wireless quantum batteries
summary: We investigate the charging dynamics and thermodynamic performance of a wireless quantum battery system mediated by a common structured bosonic environment. By employing a unified resource-theoretic analysis, we elucidate the distinct roles of non-Markovian memory effects and coupling symmetry in regulating energy transfer. In the Markovian weak-coupling regime, we identify a transformative mechanism where the dynamic reconstruction of $l_1$-norm coherence compensates for the monotonic decay of first-order coherence to sustain energy transport.
